flow.title: Train

fields.tools_summary: Building agentic AI and multi-agent systems with Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), voice AI and cloud APIs.

items.question: Which solution do I need?
items.answer: You don't need to know yet. Tell us what slows your team down and we suggest where to start. Many projects combine two or three solutions.

items.question: What happens in the free AI consultation?
items.answer: We trace one process with you, mark where work waits or repeats, and suggest what to build first. You get a one-page summary to keep, whether you work with us or not.

items.question: Can you set up AWS or Google Cloud for us?
items.answer: Yes. We set up the services a system needs in the AWS console or the Google Cloud Console: hosting, storage, databases, API keys and AI models such as Gemini on Vertex AI. The accounts stay in your company's name.

items.question: Can AI run without our data leaving our systems?
items.answer: Where it fits, yes. We can set up private or self-hosted models on your own infrastructure. Running AI locally does not make a system secure on its own, so we plan access, logging and data handling with you.

items.question: Do you only work with GoHighLevel?
items.answer: No. We use GoHighLevel when it fits, and we also build with n8n, custom websites and AI models, hosted on AWS or Google Cloud and connected to the tools you already use.

items.question: Can you work with our ERP or Tally?
items.answer: Yes. We can add an AI layer around systems like ERPNext, Tally or SAP: questions in plain words, automated MIS and alerts.

items.question: Who owns what you build?
items.answer: You do. Everything we build belongs to you and keeps running after the project ends.

items.question: Do you look after systems after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We monitor workflows and agents, fix what breaks, and add new workflows when you need them. We also train your team to use what we build.
